title.zh: 将设于北拉瑙Tubod的陆运署（LTO）延伸办公室改设为陆运署正式区办公室，并为此拨款及为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in Tubod, Lanao Del Norte Into a Regular LTO District Office, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in Tubod, Lanao Del Norte Into a Regular LTO District Office, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office located in Tubod, Lanao del Norte is hereby converted into a regular LTO District Office.
The Secretary of the Department of Transportation and Communications shall issue such rules and regulations necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO District Office in Tubod, Lanao del Norte, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Tubod LTO Extension Office. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continued implementation of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
